theorem_natural_language_statement:
Fix a compatible original-index wanted key, finite input sets and maps, local dimensions $h,J$, original modulus, and signed shift. Suppose both source-stage families, level-zero catalog, its stored record, cover group size, and raw output rows are retained. Let the previous counter be $o$ and threshold $t$. Under the separated counter/raw-row/packed-row/root/scratch layout and exact resource bounds, procedure 41 initializes the root frontier, writes its raw mass and capacity, packs the output rows, and updates the counter to $o+\operatorname{rootMass}$. It returns one precisely when this sum exceeds $t$, preserving all protected cells except the counter.
